title: meniscium standleyi
intro: Meniscium standleyi, commonly known as the Mayan fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Central America and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
